molten.name: Molten
molten.config.title: Molten Settings
molten.config.metal.enable.tooltip: Enables Metal native rendering on Apple Silicon devices
molten.config.shader.cache.tooltip: Caches compiled shaders to disk for faster loading
molten.config.command.batch.tooltip: Batches multiple render commands into a single buffer
molten.config.command.parallel.tooltip: Encodes commands in parallel across multiple cores
molten.config.command.compute.tooltip: Offloads particle updates to GPU compute
molten.config.resource.ring_buffer.toolt: Uses ring buffers for efficient memory access
molten.config.resource.unified_memory.to: Optimizes memory access for Apple Silicon unified memory architecture
molten.config.tiled.early_z.tooltip: Performs depth testing early to reduce pixel shading
molten.config.tiled.lighting.tooltip: Computes lighting per-tile for better efficiency
molten.config.debug.counters.tooltip: Shows Metal API call counts, GPU utilization, and frame time
molten.config.debug.frame_time.tooltip: Analyzes frame time distribution to identify bottlenecks
